📖 How to use

  1. Paste your article into the box.
  2. Click Rewrite Article.
  3. Review the rewritten text and the change count.
  4. Copy the result or download it as .txt.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the rewriting work?

It swaps common words with synonyms from a built-in dictionary, preserving capitalization and punctuation. It is a starting point, not a human rewrite.

Is my article uploaded anywhere?

No. Everything runs locally in your browser and your text is never uploaded or stored.

Should I publish the output as-is?

Yes — it is a template-style tool. Always review and edit the output for accuracy and tone before publishing.
